text:
eli.design: Quick proposal — regroup left nav into three tiers (Workspaces / Models / Observability) and move breadcrumbs into the top header. Sketch: https://figma.redwood/railflow

maria.pm: Do we have a URL contract for deep links? users need permalinks to a specific model + eval set.

ash.dev: Important: keep keyboard nav consistent. If breadcrumbs move to header, focus order needs to skip to main content correctly. a11y check.

eli.design: Agreed. Draft URL idea: `/app/:org/:ws/:area/:id(/:subid)?` where area ∈ [workflows, models, monitor]. Example: `/app/acme/main/models/m-123/versions/v2`

sasha.research: For inner panes (e.g., model inspection -> layers panel) I'd prefer query params for ephemeral UI state: `?panel=layers&inspect=true` so permalinks stay stable.

ash.dev: That helps caching. Also recommend stable hash fragment for scroll-to-section: `#metrics` for observability anchors.

maria.pm: How do we handle legacy links from the old sidebar? Need 301-like route aliases or fallback handler. Can we map old `/models/:id` -> new `/app/:org/:ws/models/:id` automatically?

tom_b: 301 sounds fine but watch telemetry/analytics — we should preserve UTM-like params. Also copy tweak: change breadcrumb separator from ">" to "›" for clarity in small screens.

eli.design: Noted. Also UX nit: on compact sidebar collapse, breadcrumbs should show just workspace + current area, not the full path. Keeps height down on mobile widths.

sasha.research: Accessibility nit: ensure breadcrumb links have aria-current for the active segment and that the top header supports skip links (skip to main content).

ash.dev: Routing edgecase: users bookmark a view with an incompatible model version (removed). Proposal: server returns 200 with a banner: "version not found — showing latest", and we include `?fallback=latest` in URL. avoids 404 loops.

eli.design: Love that. Can design spec a small banner + CTA to restore old version if available.

maria.pm: For deeplink testing, I'll add a small test matrix to the console e2e suite: permutations of workspace, area, version states, query params.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feat/nav-railflow v3 -> staging by @ash.dev (sha: a1b2c3)

tom_b: small follow-up: contrast on breadcrumb text when background is translucent — ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1. I'll add to checklist. :white_check_mark:

eli.design: Thanks everyone — I'll iterate the Figma and include route examples + fallback behavior. Ping if you want to pair on the a11y checklist.
